subject: english
title: 人教版初中英语八年级上册

units.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时

questions.q: She ___ her homework every evening.
Look! The boys ___ football on the playground.
一般现在时可表示客观事实，如 The earth goes around the sun.
questions.ex: 客观事实用一般现在时。

questions.q: 现在进行时表示此刻正在发生的动作。
___ your father watch TV in the evening?
questions.ex: 第三人称单数疑问用 Does。

questions.q: Listen! Someone ___ in the next room.
助动词 does 后面的动词要用原形。

units.title: 一般过去时与一般将来时

questions.q: We ___ to the zoo last Sunday.
Look at the black clouds! It ___ rain.
规则动词过去式一般加 -ed。
be going to 表示已经计划好的事。
He ___ his homework yesterday evening.
不规则动词的过去式不能按规则加 -ed。
will 常表示说话当时做出的临时决定。
He can ___ the piano very well.
This book is ___ than that one.
情态动词没有第三人称单数变化。
questions.kp: 情态动词 can / must / should

questions.q: 比较级用于两者之间的比较。
You ___ be late for school again.
questions.kp: 情态动词 can / must / should

questions.q: should 表示“应该、建议”。
